description: This file implements the RDKWindowManager class, which manages window services within the RDK framework. It includes initialization, deinitialization, and notification handling for the window manager component, and registers the service with the framework.

classes.name: RDKWindowManager
classes.description: Main class managing the RDK window service, including lifecycle management, registration, and notification handling.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the RDKWindowManager with a given service, setting up necessary components and registering for notifications.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and releases references for the service.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with service information.
